description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a market-leading AI voice agent company for mortgage lenders. Founded in 2024, the company has grown rapidly, reaching $13M in revenue within 20 months and counting 5 of the 10 largest independent mortgage banks in the U.S. as enterprise customers. If successful, the cost of homeownership could decrease by about 1%. The company is well-funded with $21M raised from top investors.
 
 Why This Is a Huge Opportunity
 Around 1% of the U.S. labor force works in phone sales, representing roughly $100B of annual salary, and the industry is poised at the brink of complete disruption. The company is at the cutting edge of this economic transformation, one of the first companies creating real, durable economic value through applied AI.
 Buying a house is the largest financial decision most people make in their lives, and homeownership is tied to many other purchases, including life insurance, homeowners insurance, alarm systems, home renovations, solar panels, and more. By owning the mortgage vertical, the company will own the relationship with the consumer, allowing it to serve as the essential AI infrastructure for high consideration consumer sales.

 Why Join
 Crazy growth: The market pull is exhilarating — the company has grown 10x in the past 12 months and more than 100x since its seed round, all without a dedicated sales or marketing team. Building something that people want so badly is the best feeling you can have in a startup.
 Team and Culture: The company is a high-agency team where the bar is high and everyone makes the people around them better. Collaboration and intensity are core team values: people truly care about their work and their coworkers. At the same time, the team doesn't take itself too seriously.
 Challenging problems: Outperforming human sales teams on half a million daily calls is not easy. Low-latency, real-time infra. 99.9% uptime. Enterprise-grade privacy and security. Advanced simulation and evaluation systems. Flexible A/B testing. AI scheduler and dialer. The company owns the whole stack and does not compromise on quality.
 Well-funded: The company has raised $21M+ in total funding, most recently a $15M Series A in June 2026.

 What You'll Do
 Define and continuously improve the company's security and privacy program
 Implement security best practices across cloud infrastructure, applications, and internal systems
 Build secure patterns and controls for internal AI agent use cases
 Own identity, access, secrets, and privileged access controls
 Lead customer security reviews and compliance efforts, including SOC 2 Type II
 Manage third-party penetration testing and drive remediation of findings
 Build technical controls to protect sensitive customer and consumer data across API, voice, and SMS systems

 What the Company Is Looking For
 3–6 years of experience in security, infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering
 Experience working at an early-stage startup, ideally Seed through Series C
 Hands-on experience securing and operating cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS
 Strong understanding of IAM, networking, secrets management, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, and cloud security best practices
 Experience implementing security controls directly, not just defining policies or requirements
 Experience working with systems that handle sensitive customer or consumer data
 Strong judgment and ability to prioritize the highest-impact security work without over-engineering
 Comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving startup environment

 Nice to Have
 Previous experience in fintech, financial services, AI software, or another regulated B2B software environment
 DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering background
 Experience securing AI/LLM applications, agent workflows, or systems that process voice, SMS, or communications data
 Experience partnering closely with product and engineering teams to design secure systems
 Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling, Kubernetes, CI/CD security, and cloud-native security tooling
 Experience helping an early-stage company mature its security program as it moves upmarket

 Benefits
 Top-of-market medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
 401(k) with a top-of-market employer match
 Unlimited PTO
 Snacks, weekly team lunches, and dinner on the company
 Hybrid in-office schedule: four days a week together in SF, with a flexible remote day on Wednesdays
